subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: May OpenClaw intentionally stop supporting custom DeepInfra `nativeBaseUrl` endpoints on upgrade, or must this PR preserve that shipped endpoint contract?
rationale: A URL rewrite cannot prove that an arbitrary custom native endpoint implements DeepInfra's separate asynchronous OpenAI videos protocol, so the safe permanent contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve custom endpoints
options.body: Migrate only the known default DeepInfra native URL and preserve or explicitly model custom native endpoint protocol behavior with upgrade tests.

options.title: Approve the break
options.body: Intentionally retire custom native endpoints, make doctor fail with an actionable explanation instead of silently rewriting them, and document the upgrade impact.

options.title: Split the fixes
options.body: Land the independent DeepSeek thinking-format repair and defer the video endpoint migration until the compatibility contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve custom endpoints
recommendation.body: Migrate only the known default DeepInfra native URL and preserve or explicitly model custom native endpoint protocol behavior with upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct reviewer involvement on the compatibility question and this decision affects the shipped provider configuration contract.
